input.quote: 19.4 For breach of Section 19.1 or 19.2, Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge. If Vendor cannot do so within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it.
input.rationale: The warranty package satisfies our checklist. §19.1 warrants professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel and material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications, with no durational cut-off (so the Services warranty comfortably exceeds the 30-day fallback floor); §19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformity period running from the later of delivery or acceptance and term-long conformity for Hosted Services; §19.3 adds malicious-code and Applicable Law warranties; and §19.4 provides re-performance/repair/replacement plus terminate-and-refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The §19.5 disclaimer is mutual and expressly does not limit any express warranty or remedy, so it does not swallow the warranties. This sits at or above the fallback (and meets most preferred elements); the only shortfall is that the standalone software/Deliverable conformity period is 90 days rather than the preferred 12 months — noted but not worth redlining given the term-long hosted conformity warranty and the strong, non-exclusive remedy stack.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
